shell.footerNote: Analysis identity and measurements stay independent of display language.

workspace.title: Analysis Workspace
workspace.intro: Draw one area of interest, choose an inclusive Gregorian date range, and review the saved analysis when the service is connected.
workspace.mapDescription: Draw a single polygon on the map. Geographic orientation stays fixed in every language.
workspace.mapNotReady: The interactive map is not ready yet.
workspace.mapFailure: The map or polygon drawing control could not be loaded. Area drawing is unavailable.
workspace.mapFailureDetail: Check the map connection and reload this page.
workspace.mapAttribution: Map tiles: MapLibre demo tiles. Map data attribution is shown by the map.
workspace.drawingHelp: Click map points to draw. Double-click to finish the polygon.
workspace.areaDrawn: One polygon is ready for validation.
workspace.coordinateInstructions: For keyboard entry, paste one GeoJSON Polygon or Feature containing one Polygon ring. Coordinates use longitude, latitude order.
workspace.dateHelp: Gregorian calendar dates, inclusive. The service interval uses UTC.
workspace.runUnavailable: No analysis was submitted. The backend contract is not available in this build.
workspace.notSubmittedDetail: No analysis request has been sent.
workspace.savedStatusPending: This ID has not been checked with the backend yet.
workspace.noResult: No result is available because no saved analysis has been loaded.
workspace.savedResultPending: A result cannot be loaded until the backend contract is pinned.
workspace.provenanceUnavailable: Coverage and provenance facts appear here after a real result is loaded.
workspace.ndviLegendUnavailable: The NDVI legend is shown with a real backend preview.
workspace.workspaceDisclosure: This workspace does not calculate or simulate satellite analysis in the browser.

settings.title: Settings / Data Sources
settings.description: Read-only status for the allowlisted data sources configured by the backend.
settings.statusUnavailable: Source status is not available because the backend contract is not pinned in this build.
settings.statusUnavailableDetail: No source checks were requested. This page does not infer reachability or scientific coverage from source names.
settings.sourceFieldsHeading: Status shown when the service is connected
settings.checkState: Last recorded check state and timestamp
settings.checkScope: Check scope, such as catalogue access or pixel reading
settings.settingsDisclosure: Provider credentials and source configuration remain in reviewed backend settings.

errors.invalidGeoJson: The text is not valid GeoJSON.
errors.unsupportedGeometry: Use one Polygon with one outer ring. MultiPolygon and holes are not supported.
errors.invalidCoordinates: Coordinates must be finite longitude and latitude pairs within WGS84 bounds.
errors.invalidPolygon: The polygon must be closed, have positive area, and not cross itself.
errors.antimeridianUnsupported: Polygons crossing the 180° meridian are not supported.
errors.tooManyVertices: The polygon exceeds the 500 vertex limit.
errors.areaTooLarge: The polygon exceeds the 5,000 km² request limit.
errors.dateMissing: Choose both a start date and an end date.
errors.dateOrder: The start date must be on or before the end date.
errors.dateSpanTooLong: The inclusive date range cannot exceed 120 days.
errors.INPUT_INVALID: The analysis input was rejected. Review the area and date range.
errors.LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The analysis exceeds a configured workload limit.
errors.NOT_READY: The saved result is not ready yet.
errors.SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE: A required data source is unavailable.
errors.PROCESSING_FAILED: The analysis could not be completed.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: This request key was already used with different analysis input.
errors.unknownBackendError: The service returned an unrecognized error. Reference: {requestId}
errors.draftStorageUnavailable: This browser could not preserve the current draft. Keep this tab open while changing languages.
